decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin and be completed not later than 3 months from the date of this decision.

The existing extraction duct at rear, shall cease and be demolished to flat roof level and be removed and all equipment and materials brought onto the land for the purposes of such use/materials resulting from the demolition shall be removed within 30 days of the date of this notice.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:</p><ul><li>Site Location and Block Plan, entitled Drawing No:001;</li><li>Pre-Existing Floor Plans, Elevations, Sections and Roof entitled Drawing No: 010 Rev B;</li><li>Existing Floor Plans, Elevations, Sections and Roof entitled Drawing No: 011 Rev B;</li><li>Proposed Floor Plans, Elevations, Sections and Roof entitled Drawing No: 012 Rev C;</li><li>Heritage Statement entitled; 003;</li><li>Noise Impact Assessment (DAA GROUP) Issue 01, Dated on 20th August 2024,&nbsp;</li><li>Kitchen Extraction &amp; Odour Control System Proposal (Fan Services Ltd), Dated on 6th September 2024;</li></ul>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be installed in accordance with all the specifications, components prescribed Noise Impact Assessment (DAA GROUP) Issue 01, Dated 20th August 2024, as well as Kitchen Extraction &amp; Odour Control System Proposal (Fan Services Ltd), Dated 6th September 2024.&nbsp; Thereafter, a Post Test Verification Report shall first have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, any measures suggested or indicated shall thereafter remain in perpetuity.&nbsp;</p>

The external noise level emitted from AC unit, or equipment at the development hereby approved shall be lower than the lowest existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, as assessed according to BS 4142:2014+A1:2019 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

<div>The proposed extraction fan, or equipment at the development hereby approved shall be operated on the premises only between the following hours: 07.00 and 23:00 Mondays - Sundays and shall not be operated at any time on Bank or Public Holidays.</div>
description: Installation of extract duct at rear (Removal of existing extract duct)
